item.text: Agence Europe reports that Friedrich Merz asked António Costa in a letter of 6 November to link fair sharing of the 2027 Ukraine aid gap, about €70bn, to the MFF 2028–2034 talks. Finland and Estonia oppose the link.

Agence Europe reports that the Irish Presidency asked ambassadors on 11 November to clarify the partner origin concept, reciprocity and the low-carbon method. No clear majority backs its latest low-carbon compromise.
Agence Europe reports that France, now backed by Germany, wants the Made in Europe scope extended to Switzerland and the United Kingdom. The automotive provisions went to Coreper on 11 November.
MLex reports that IMCO recommended on 10 November, in its opinion on the Digital Omnibus, that cloud providers be exempt from some switching obligations for certain older contracts.
Agence Europe reports that Council and Parliament negotiators held the third and penultimate TEN-E trilogue on 10 November. The final round is planned for early December.
Agence Europe reports that the AGRI, BUDG and REGI committees will not vote on the National and Regional Partnership Plans regulation before January 2027. The vote had been planned for December.

Agence Europe reports that the European Data Protection Supervisor published an opinion on the KIDS Act on 12 November. It recommends that age verification duties apply only once privacy-preserving solutions are available across the EU.
MLex reports that the two MEPs leading Parliament work on the Cloud and AI Development Act set out a draft report that seeks to streamline approval procedures and address energy constraints.
